details:
Overview

If the game closes or you are returned to the Home World due to an error in the instance you are currently in, you cannot return to the original instance.

However, you may be able to return after several tens of minutes have passed.

Steps to Reproduce

1. Join a friend’s instance.

2. An error occurs or the PC shuts down unexpectedly.

*Note: This cannot be reproduced by force-killing the process (taskkill /f /t /im vrchat.exe).

3. Launch VRChat.

4. Return to the friend’s instance from earlier.

Observed Behavior

Upon entering, you are forcibly returned to the Home World. After repeating this several times, the error “World transition is too fast (Error Code 429)” appears.

Error Details

・Resetting game flow because “Destination instance set”: [SkipLogin, RemainInNetworkRoom]

・OnJoinRoomFailed(32752, “You cannot enter this instance at this time, please try again later”)

You can confirm error logs like these

The following error might also be one of the causes

title: An error occurs when entering the instance
